Flight Controller.Notes: Flash the MatekH743-bdshot firmware target for bidirectional DShot RPM telemetry; the output layout also fits the plain MatekH743 target. ESCs on outputs 3-5 (output 6 stays unused because it shares a timer with output 5). Servos on 7-11 (timer group 7-10 plus output 11).

Frame.Notes: Tilt-rotor tricopter (Q_FRAME_CLASS=7) with vectored yaw (Q_TILT_TYPE=2). The front-right (motor 1, output 3) and front-left (motor 2, output 5) motors tilt (Q_TILT_MASK=3); the rear motor 4 (output 4) is fixed in the lift position. Tilt servos on outputs 8 (right) and 9 (left), ailerons on 7, elevator on 10, and output 11 set to Motor 7 (tri tail yaw servo function). 790 mm wingspan, no rudder.

Battery Monitor.Notes: Onboard voltage divider and high-precision current sensor. The WLITE needs BATT_VOLT_MULT=21 and BATT_AMP_PERVLT=66.7, not the H743-Wing defaults. Calibrate both against a meter.

Battery.Notes: Placeholder 4S pack: set chemistry and capacity to match your battery. HeeWing requires 4S for VTOL flight. For a 21700 Li-ion pack, select LiIon chemistry.

ESC.Notes: Three ESCs: output 3 (front right), output 4 (rear) and output 5 (front left). Bidirectional DShot needs Bluejay firmware on the BLHeli_S ESCs: check with esc-configurator and flash if needed. Stock BLHeli_S does not answer bidirectional DShot and the motors will not spin.

Motors.Notes: Three motors: two tilting wing motors and one fixed rear lift motor

GNSS Receiver.Notes: GNSS on the GPS1 port (SERIAL3 = USART2: TX2/RX2). The QMC5883L compass on the same module connects to the I2C pads (CL1/DA1) and is auto-detected, with orientation auto-detected (COMPASS_AUTO_ROT=2).

RC Controller.Notes: Any EdgeTX handset. Set the ELRS Packet Rate and Switch Mode (Hybrid or 16ch/2) in the ELRS Lua script. MAVLink mode forces a 1:2 telemetry ratio.

RC Transmitter.Notes: The ELRS TX module must run Link Mode = MAVLink. On ELRS v4 the receiver's serial protocol switches to MAVLink automatically. Connect the GCS through the TX backpack (WiFi/UDP) or the module's USB.

RC Receiver.Notes: MAVLink over ELRS: RC channels arrive as MAVLink RADIO_RC_CHANNELS on the same UART as telemetry (SERIAL1 = UART7: TX7/RX7, no CTS/RTS wired). Receiver TX goes to FC RX7 and receiver RX to FC TX7.

Telemetry.Notes: Same physical XR4 receiver as the RC Receiver: MAVLink2 at 460800 baud, with the MAV2_* stream rates (SERIAL1 is the second MAVLink port after USB) set per the ExpressLRS MAVLink guide.
